corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Depends, HTTPException, Header
import hashlib

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/backups")

@router.post("/{session_id}/stream-chunk")
async def append_backup_chunk(
    session_id: str,
    request: Request,
    content_range: str = Header(...),
    backup_storage: BackupStorageService = Depends(get_backup_storage),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    session = await backup_storage.get_session(session_id)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Upload session not found")
    if session.user_id != current_user.id and not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to modify this backup session")

    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    async for chunk in request.stream():
        hasher.update(chunk)
        await backup_storage.write_chunk_bytes(session_id, chunk)

    await backup_storage.update_session_progress(session_id, hasher.hexdigest())
    return {"status": "chunk_appended", "session_id": session_id}
